name: Warhammer Skulls 2025 Digital Goodie Bag
description:
The Digital Goodie Bag is available and free to claim only until May 29th, 4 PM UTC.



All the warriors of the Old World and 41st Millennium, hear us! To celebrate the Warhammer Skulls festival, Games Workshop and GOG have teamed up to present you with this outstanding Warhammer Skulls 2025 Digital Goodie Bag that is available only in our store.  

The digital Goodie bag contains:

  • Warhammer Skulls 2025 Wallpapers
  • Battlesector Wallpapers
  • Cubicle 7 Discount QR flyer (20% off all Warhammer Products apart from Pre-Orders) 22/5- 5/6
  • Warhammer ART Discount (20% off with the code for all personalized gifting items) 22/05-31/05

Warhammer Skulls 2025 Digital Goodie Bag will appear in your library as a separate entry. Please note that the goodies are accessible only through the browser and will not be visible in your GOG GALAXY library.



Discover the grim dark universes of Warhammer where there is only war. From Warhammer 40,000 to Warhammer Fantasy and more - discover it all on GOG Warhammer Franchise page.
